args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 after the latest deploy. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 both healthy; v2.3.1 unhealthy).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. The rollback was verified: all three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
